messages:
jess_sales: Heads up team — POC with NovaLedger (tenant: nova-890) started failing during their combined embeddings+chat demo. They see intermittent 429s across /v1/embeddings and /v1/chat. Demo script runs both in parallel. Can someone help triage?

dylan_eng: Oof. Do they get the same 429 error payload on both routes? Any request ids? Also which models are they calling for each route?

jess_sales: They sent two error snippets: `{"error":"429","type":"rate_limit","msg":"quota exhausted"}` from embeddings and `{"error":"429","type":"rate_limit","msg":"per-route cap"}` from chat. Models: embeddings-v1-small and redwood-chat-8k. They provided request ids for a few calls: r-0091, r-0092, r-0098. Happened around 2026-03-22T09:02:14Z.

rita_oncall: I'm pulling logs now. Suspect cross-route token accounting: trial tenants have a small global token pool plus per-route soft caps; running embeddings is token-heavy and can eat the global budget causing 429s downstream. Give me a minute.

omar_sre: Log snippets attached: ```
[09:02:12Z] tenant=nova-890 route=/v1/embeddings tokens=4800 global_available=2000 -> 200 OK (r-0091)
[09:02:13Z] tenant=nova-890 route=/v1/chat tokens=1600 global_available=400 -> 429 quota_exhausted (r-0092)
[09:02:14Z] tenant=nova-890 route=/v1/embeddings tokens=3200 global_available=400 -> 429 quota_exhausted (r-0098)
```

omar_sre: Conclusion: global tenant token pool hit zero due to concurrent heavy embedding requests; chat hits per-route soft cap while global budget is low. It's a cross-route exhaustion pattern.

jess_sales: Customer wants immediate fix. They are in the middle of a sales demo and ask for minimal changes. Options?

dylan_eng: Short-term: 1) apply an emergency global token bump for tenant (small TTL) so demo can finish; 2) temporarily pause embeddings for a minute while chat completes; 3) change demo script to serialize heavy calls. I can run the bump if given authorization. CLI: `redwood admin set-global-burst --tenant nova-890 --add-tokens 10000 --ttl 20m`

rita_oncall: I'm okay to apply a conservative bump; will monitor. Also recommend adding a safeguard: route-level priority so interactive chat gets preferential routing during demos. Post-demo we can schedule a follow-up to discuss Dedicated or reserved global pool.

jess_sales: Customer verbally approved a short bump. Please proceed — they need the last 10 minutes of the demo to complete.

rita_oncall: Applying: `/ops tenant update --tenant nova-890 --global-burst +10000 --ttl 20m` -> op_nova_20260322_01

deploy-bot: Operation op_nova_20260322_01 started by rita_oncall.

omar_sre: After bump logs: ```
[09:02:45Z] tenant=nova-890 route=/v1/chat tokens=1400 global_available=9000 -> 200 OK (r-0102)
[09:02:46Z] tenant=nova-890 route=/v1/embeddings tokens=4200 global_available=4800 -> 200 OK (r-0103)
```

jess_sales: Customer confirmed demo completed and they saw no further 429s. They asked for guidance to avoid this in future POCs.

dylan_eng: Hand-off notes for sales: - For POCs that run mixed workloads, estimate peak token simultaneous usage (embeddings are typically 1k-5k tokens per call). - Prefer sequential demo flows or set explicit delays between heavy jobs. - Offer a trial demo config: reserved soft-pool for interactive routes or temporary per-POC allocation. - Recommend Dedicated or reserved global budget for production.

omar_sre: I'll create a KB entry titled "Mixed-workload POC: cross-route token exhaustion" with troubleshooting steps, recommended demo scripts, and the CLI commands used. Also add an automated alert rule to surface global pool < 20% earlier.

jess_sales: Thanks all. I'll email NovaLedger the mitigation summary and next steps. Closing thread unless anyone objects.
